race.comment: EXTREMELY ROWDY (7) did her best work late to score by 0.6 lengths last time out over 1050m at this track at the second run of the campaign. Even fitter and can go close again. BOHEMIAN ANGEL (12) is also third-up from a break and looks ready to fire. Has placed at both runs this time in and appeals as the main danger. COMMON INTEREST (9) hasn't raced since he was safely held in the Adelaide Guineas. Has won fresh and looks all set for a effective return. POWER DANCER (10) finished 2.25 lengths from the winner in fifth last start over 1250m at Morphettville Parks. Boxed on fairly and looks well placed here. Among the main chances. MANSIERE (3) raced on speed here two back and just missed then lifted strongly to score by a nose on the Parks track ;latest. Racing well and has to be included.
